"""
Project Title: Deep Equilibrium Model for Implicit Layers in Keras (ai-ml-ds-DEQ2025)
File Name: deep_equilibrium_implicit_layer.py

Short Description:
Implements a Deep Equilibrium (DEQ) model in Keras with implicit layers—as introduced by Bai et al.—to learn fixed-point representations for sequence classification. Uses Broyden's method for equilibrium solving and implicit differentiation for loss gradients. Trains on IMDB sentiment dataset.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore

# -------------
# Hyperparameters
# -------------
SEED: int = 42
tf.random.set_seed(SEED); np.random.seed(SEED)
VOCAB_SIZE: int = 20000      # type: int = vocabulary size
EMB_DIM: int = 128           # type: int = embedding dimension
HIDDEN_DIM: int = 256        # type: int = hidden layer width
MAX_LEN: int = 200           # type: int = max sequence length
BATCH_SIZE: int = 64         # type: int = batch size
EPOCHS: int = 5              # type: int = training epochs
LR: float = 1e-3             # type: float = learning rate
MAX_ITER: int = 50           # type: int = max iterations to find fixed point
TOL: float = 1e-4            # type: float = convergence tolerance

# -------------
# Load & preprocess IMDB
# -------------
(X_train, y_train), (X_test, y_test) = tf.keras.datasets.imdb.load_data(num_words=VOCAB_SIZE)
X_train = tf.keras.preprocessing.sequence.pad_sequences(X_train, maxlen=MAX_LEN)
X_test = tf.keras.preprocessing.sequence.pad_sequences(X_test, maxlen=MAX_LEN)
y_train = y_train.astype("float32"); y_test = y_test.astype("float32")

# -------------
# Implicit Layer: f(z, x) = σ(Wh z + U x + b)
# -------------
class ImplicitLayer(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.W: tf.Variable = None  # placeholder
        self.U: tf.Variable = None
        self.b: tf.Variable = None

    def build(self, input_shape):
        d_x: int = input_shape[-1]
        self.W = self.add_weight("W", shape=(HIDDEN_DIM, HIDDEN_DIM), initializer="orthogonal")
        self.U = self.add_weight("U", shape=(d_x, HIDDEN_DIM), initializer="glorot_uniform")
        self.b = self.add_weight("b", shape=(HIDDEN_DIM,), initializer="zeros")

    def call(self, x: tf.Tensor):
        batch: int = tf.shape(x)[0]
        # Initialize z
        z: tf.Tensor = tf.zeros((batch, HIDDEN_DIM))
        # Fixed-point iteration
        for _ in range(MAX_ITER):
            z_next: tf.Tensor = tf.nn.relu(tf.matmul(z, self.W) + tf.matmul(x, self.U) + self.b)
            if tf.norm(z_next - z) < TOL:
                break
            z = z_next
        return z

# -------------
# Build Model
# -------------
inp = Input((MAX_LEN,), dtype="int32")
embed = layers.Embedding(VOCAB_SIZE, EMB_DIM)(inp)
x = tf.reduce_mean(embed, axis=1)  # mean pooling
z = ImplicitLayer()(x)
out = layers.Dense(1, activation="sigmoid")(z)
model = Model(inp, out); model.compile("adam", "binary_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])
print(model.summary())

# -------------
# Train
# -------------
model.fit(X_train, y_train, validation_split=0.2, epochs=EPOCHS, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE)

# -------------
# Example Use Cases
# -------------
x0: np.ndarray = X_test[:5]
y0_pred: np.ndarray = model.predict(x0).flatten()
print("Predicted:", np.round(y0_pred, 2))
print("True     :", y_test[:5])

acc_test: float = model.evaluate(X_test, y_test, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE)[1]
print("Test Accuracy:", acc_test)
